subject: Hosted API per-token tiers & compliance pre-conditions
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@bigfinanalytics.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing + compliance pre-conditions

Hi Ava,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. BigFin Analytics is evaluating hosted inference for a customer-facing feature that will generate ~1.2B tokens/month in steady state (peaks up to ~1.8B). We are interested in your per-token hosted API model but need clarity on:

- Tiered commit pricing (what breakpoints, committed vs overage rates)
- Whether discounted pricing is conditional on signed security paperwork (DPA / SOC 2 evidence) and timelines
- Any short-term staging options while compliance paperwork is in flight

Can you share a term sheet / price sketch and confirm what you require from a compliance perspective before the discounted rates kick in? Our procurement and security teams will want to review the DPA and SOC 2 report before we commit.

Also attaching a short security questionnaire our side will fill out (I will upload the completed file once we have the redlines).

Thanks,
Elena Morales
VP, Product
BigFin Analytics

Attachment: BigFin_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (stub)

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@bigfinanalytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-12T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing + compliance pre-conditions

Hi Elena — really appreciate the details and the projected volume. Quick sketch on our side:

- No commit: $0.0009 / token (list for hosted generation)
- Tier 1 (>=200M tokens/mo commit): $0.00065 / token
- Tier 2 (>=800M tokens/mo commit): $0.00045 / token
- Tier 3 (>=1.5B tokens/mo commit): $0.00030 / token

Overage is billed at a blended overage rate between the committed tier and list (we can show a worked example). Standard minimum term for those tiers is 12 months. Pricing assumes typical generation vs embedding mix — if your token mix is heavy on long generations we should model it out.

Compliance gating: for any discounted committed tier we require a signed DPA and an available SOC 2 Type II report (summary + auditor letter) before the discounted billing takes effect. In practice teams often sign the MSA + DPA and we apply the discount retroactively to the start of the committed term once SOC 2 evidence is received.

Short-term options: we can provide provisional staging credits (one-off) while DPA review is in flight so you can start traffic at production scale. Also happy to send our pricing-deck and a draft DPA for redlines — attaching both.

Would you like to schedule a 30-minute sync with our compliance lead (neha_kapoor) and finance (marcus_lin) to align timelines?

Best,
Ava Chen
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing-deck.pdf (stub), Redwood_DPA_draft_202606.pdf (stub)

From: Elena Morales <elena@bigfinanalytics.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: BigFin Analytics Procurement <procurement@bigfinanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-06-12T13:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing + compliance pre-conditions

Thanks Ava — that tier schedule is helpful. A few clarifying points from procurement/security:

- We will need the SOC 2 Type II report and control mapping to our SOC 2 questionnaire before legal will sign a long-term commit.
- Two-week turnaround for us to review and return redlines on the DPA would be ideal — is that feasible?
- Can Redwood accommodate a clause that discounts are contingent on SOC 2 evidence, but that we retain the right to escrow or halt commitments if evidence is materially delayed?

If you can provide the SOC 2 summary behind NDA we can start the security review immediately. Also please confirm whether data residency controls for US-only processing are supported for this offering.

Elena

Attachment: (we will return the filled questionnaire shortly)

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@bigfinanalytics.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-13T08:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing + compliance pre-conditions

Elena — looping in Neha (security/compliance) and Marcus (finance/discounts). To set expectations and unblock things quickly, here's the checklist and policy that we typically follow for tiered per-token discounts:

1) Execute MSA + DPA (we'll send a draft). Redlines are fine; Legal typically turns around in ~10 business days.
2) Provide SOC 2 Type II report summary + auditor letter behind NDA. Full report access via secure portal on request.
3) We will not enable committed discount billing until the DPA is signed and SOC 2 evidence is available. However, we apply the discount retroactively to the start of the committed term if paperwork clears afterward (this is our standard practice for enterprise commits).
4) If SOC 2 evidence is delayed >30 days after the agreed term start, Redwood reserves the right to revert to list rates for the period until evidence is supplied — we can add a 30-day remediation window in the DPA.
5) Data residency: US-only processing is supported for Hosted in our US region. We'll note that in the DPA.

As a gesture to get you running, we can provide a one-time staging credit equal to one month of Tier 2 pricing while DPA review proceeds. To proceed we need the completed security questionnaire and the legal contact for DPA redlines.

Attaching a short compliance checklist to make it easy for your team to see what we need.

Best,
Ava

Attachment: compliance-checklist.xlsx (stub)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@bigfinanalytics.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-14T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing + compliance pre-conditions — SOC 2 access

Hi Elena — nice to e-meet you. Per Ava's checklist: we can provide a SOC 2 Type II summary and control mapping under NDA. Next steps from our side:

- I'll send a secure link to the SOC 2 summary and the auditor letter (restricted access).
- If you need control evidence for specific sections of your questionnaire we can provide a time-boxed evidence packet (usually 5–7 business days to assemble).
- For data residency: we will add the US-only processing clause to the DPA and annotate the controls that map to encryption and isolation.

Please share the procurement/legal contact and confirm the NDA scope; I'll open the portal access as soon as that's in place.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Related link: https://app.redwood.com/secure/docs/soc2/summary?token=REDACTED

From: Elena Morales <elena@bigfinanalytics.com>

Date: 2026-06-16T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing + compliance pre-conditions

Neha/Ava — thanks for the quick turnaround. Procurement has confirmed we'll sign the NDA and return the questionnaire by tomorrow. A couple of requests before we proceed with the 1.5B tier commit:

- Can Redwood confirm whether the retroactive discount will be applied automatically once SOC 2 evidence is provided, or whether that requires a separate finance/credit approval?
- We would like the 30-day remediation window to be explicit in the DPA; can your legal team accept that language?

If the answers are yes/yes, we're prepared to move to a 12-month Tier 3 commit with a start date of 2026-07-01 pending DPA redlines. I'll upload BigFin_Security_Questionnaire.pdf shortly.

Elena
